taxes.quote: I move that property taxes be levied for the 2026 tax year by the adoption of a total tax rate of $1.1169. ... This motion, made by Dr. Gloria Gonzales-Dholakia and seconded by Sade Fashokun, passed six in favor and one absent.
taxes.context: Recorded vote as Leander ISD trustee, Aug 17, 2026 minutes (approved Sept 3). Rate exceeds the voter-approval rate of $1.0869 per the Aug 17 agenda: https://meetings.boardbook.org/Public/DownloadAgenda/795?meeting=757600. +3 not +5: a single district rate vote, not a stated philosophy.
